root_cause_role: RSU CPU capacity is 100-400x larger than task compute demand, making pure compute latency negligible.
Dominates per-task physical delay (~1.0s) under Shannon Eq. 1 uplink physics.
High bandwidth optical backhaul delivers rapid subtask transfer while consuming ~3.5-4.0 J.
In 10-vehicle realization traces, queue contention remains low, preventing multi-second backlog build-up.
The paper's headline 13.90s/25.14J represents either cumulative delay over task DAG sequences or an unstated 10x-larger task payload.
